chapter_title: Concerning the Light Mind and the Apostles and the Saints
chapter_note: The chapter’s oldest substrate dominates the middle: a systematic macrocosm↔microcosm correspondence (universe-as-human; five/six-fold sons; watch-district rebellions; then the body’s five-member binding and the Light Mind’s reversal). The opening Q&A and the closing apostolate-boast are hagiographic frame; the second-half drift (¶44–50) is clearly institutional/pastoral (church officers, rebuke, community management). Several paragraphs are MIXED where the editor appends institutional application (church/apostles persecution; idolatry polemic) to otherwise cosmological teaching.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Hagiographic dialogue container (“Once again… a disciple… the [apostle]”), reporting prior teaching rather than expounding it directly; Q&A frame signals compilation layer.
Continuation of the disciple’s question (“I see… rebellions arise…”); interrogative frame rather than impersonal exposition.
Second interrogative (“I ask you…”), still within Q&A container; no systematic exposition.
Fragmentary third question; question-voice belongs to the compilation frame.
Fourth question (“why is his likeness not displayed…”), Q&A frame.
Fifth question about apostolate and persecution “in the world” (hagiographic topic), still dialogue frame.
Entreaty formula (“I entreat you…”): explicit frame marker.
Dialogue attribution + institutional anchoring (“my chu[r]c[h]”); editorial/hagiographic apparatus.
Dialogue continuation (“disciple says… [apost]l[e]”); frame.
Dialogue attribution (“Then the apostle says…”) + performative rhetoric (“give vision…”); not impersonal system-description.

paragraphs.core_text: All the error, when the en[e]my of the lights constructed it, he constructed after the likeness of a man. The head of the universe is the beginning of the garments. [H]is neck is the nape of the garm[ents]. His stomach is the five unfolded ones (?), which a[re ... ] of the garm[e]nts. His ribs are all the firmament[s]. His navel is the sphere of the stars and the signs of the zodiac. And, also, [the par]ts [that] come from his navel to his hip are [...] that come from the sphere t[o the corne]rs of the four worlds. His loins are the th[ree eart]hs that are below [...] upon the head of the Porter. His [...] from the [...] to the earth upon which the Porter [is stood] firm. His shins and his feet a[re ...] and the entire zone that belongs [...]
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution: “Then speaks the apostle to him:” (compilation frame marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core correspondential substrate: universe-as-human body map (domain→domain), impersonal systematic anatomy-to-cosmos correspondences. Mixed only because of the dialogue attribution.

paragraphs.core_text: His heart is mankind. His liver is the four-footed animals. His lung is the race of birds that [fly in] the air. His spleen is the race of fish that swim in the waters. His kidneys are the world of reptiles that creep [up]on the earth. His outer skin is the wall that [... which] surrounds the piercing and the great fire. His [...] the vessels of the great fire. His [...] of darkness. His gall is the [... His] great intestine is the breadth of the great [...] of the worlds. His veins [...] all [the spri]ngs and wells. His e[yes (?) ...] His feet are his [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic macrocosm↔microcosm mapping in correspondential registers; no institutional anchoring.

paragraphs.core_text: This is how each of the worlds h[ave been ha]rmonised (?). Five gods are fastened in him. [...] they are his soul and his life [...] man is a sinner [...] the Living Spirit and the Ambassador [...] the five sleepless guardians.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-system integration (five gods/guardians) continuing the body-universe harmonisation; minor moral wording does not pivot to institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: He has [...] the Keeper of Splendour, the mind that is [...] in the wo[r]ld of the mind that is above. He has [...] who]le [...] of the powers of hea[ven that] are in [...] of the great King of Honour, [who is the thought that exists i]n the seventh firmament. He has humbled [...] also of the Adamant of Lig[h]t, who is the insight [... ] from he has given [...] because of lust [... He has] also appointed the King of Glory, who is the coun[sel ...] patience over the three images; that of wind, that of fire, and that of water. He has handed over to him the [...] do evilness. [...] the Porter, who is the consideration [...] the wi]sdom in the [...] which is below. He has made him [...] the foundation [below ...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Five-fold intellectual qualities mapped onto cosmic watch-keepers/firmaments; impersonal structural exposition (core).

paragraphs.core_text: Furthermore: The Ambassador refined from them five intellectuals of life. Also, the summons and the obedience were situated there. Now, they made six sons of the Living Spirit, together with the six sons of the First Man!
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered/structured cosmology (five→six sons; beings-as-functions) is characteristic of the teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: Further: The Ambassador placed in them the great Mind; who is the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic identification within the cosmic hierarchy (Mind=Pillar of Glory=Perfect Man).

paragraphs.core_text: Furthermore: Jesus the Youth was set there; who is the image of the living word, of the utterance and the obedience.
paragraphs.temporal_note: ‘Jesus the Youth’ functions here as a defined cosmic hypostasis (not a Gospel citation), embedded in the six-son structure.

paragraphs.core_text: He has made strong these camps, those above and those below [...], (so that) each one of them will be secure in the circuit of his watch-district, so that neither uprising nor treachery are made in his watch-district.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic ‘watch-district’ governance mechanics; impersonal, systemic voice.

paragraphs.core_text: And look, see! The Keeper of Splendour is set firm in the great mind, in the camp above the prison of the bound ones, for he brings to nothing all the gloom of death. An[d a] treachery came about, and an uprising! The Sin abor[te]d, [it t]angled i]n with the soul. It became mixed with this light that it expelled toward the image of the Ambassador. It went [...] in the third firmament that is above the watch-t[ower ...] the Keeper of Splendour. From that place also it tangled in with the light. It was detached and came down to that which is dry and that which is moist. It [fashio]ned the trees [up]on the dry (land); but in the sea it immediat[ely] took form and made a great uprising in the sea.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic rebellion narrative remains internal to the system (Sin as a cosmological agent affecting firmaments/elements).

paragraphs.core_text: Again, look, see! The great King of Honour, who is the thought, he is in the thi[r]d firmament. He is made [...] with wrath. And an uprising came about! A treachery and a[n] anger happened in his camp. The watchers of heaven, who came down to the earth in his watch-district, they did all the deeds of treachery. They have revealed crafts in the world and have unveiled to people the mysteries of heaven. An uprising came about, and a destruction, on the earth [... ] to it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mythic cosmogonic history tied to a specific watch-district; still cosmos→cosmos (watchers/firmament/earth as arena), not church-specific administration.

paragraphs.core_text: The Adamant [...] the fulfillment. He is set firm upo[n ...] and a treachery came about in his camp; the occasion when the abortions fell to the earth. They formed Adam and Eve. They begat them so as to reign through them in the world. They fashioned every object of lust upon the earth. The entire world was filled by their lust.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed late institutional/application extension: “Also, [...] they persecute the churches. They kill the apostles and the righteous… from generation to generation.” This crosses from cosmic myth to community history (cosmos→contemporary institution).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core cosmogonic account (abortions→Adam/Eve→lust-filling world) is old; the appended persecution of ‘churches/apostles’ anchors to institutional present.

paragraphs.core_text: Once again: In the watch of the great King of Glory, wh[o] is the great counsel, he who exercises authority over the thre[e] wheels. A [dis]turbance came about, and an affliction, for [they were ... ] pained and oppressed in the three earths. After the Ambassador displayed his image, the paths closed to their [...] their ascent was impeded by them [...] the w[ind], the water, and the fire ascend on them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System mechanics (three wheels/three earths; ascent-path impediments; element ascent) remain within the cosmological architecture.

paragraphs.core_text: [O]nce again: In the watch of the Porter, he who humiliates [...] upr]ising of the abysses below [...] bent, the fastenings underneath were loosened [...] in the foundation below.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic foundation/fastenings/abysses—structural cosmology language.

paragraphs.core_text: On account of the earthquake that happened in the watch of the Keeper of Splen[dour], the Pillar of Glory came forth; as it [...] helper of the Keeper of Splendour. It bore up under all [burden]s.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal cosmic causality: watch-district event → emanation/response by a named cosmic entity.

paragraphs.core_text: Conversely, because of the treachery and the uprising that happened in the watch of the great King of Honour, which is the watchers who came down to earth from the heavens; four angels were called upon about them. They bound the watche[r]s with an eternal chain, in the prison of the blackened ones (?). [Th]ey obliterated their children from upon the earth.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic juridical mechanism (binding/chain/prison) described as process, not moral exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: [Th]en, again, the abortions descended in the watch of the Adamant and begat Adam and Eve; because of that great treachery wh[ich] happened, and the mystery of wickedness, he sent Jesus [...] the prayer of the five sons. He assumed them [...] the abortions. He fastened them beneath the [...] the mind of Adam.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mythic intervention by ‘Jesus’ as a cosmic agent (no Gospel citation formula), tied to five-sons structure.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, because of the earthquake that happened in these three earths, and in that the paths were hindered and the springs of wind and water and fire were impeded, Jesus cast himself down. He assumed Eve; and he straightened the tracks of the [win]d, the water, and the fire. He opened the springs for them, and he set [in ord]er the path of their ascent.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Elemental ascent mechanics and cosmic descent/ascent action; remains within system description.

paragraphs.core_text: Once [again]: Since the earth beneath the Porter was loose[ned from] the fastenings that [...] because of this too Jesus went down, assuming [Ev]e until he reached tha[t] place. [H]e set in [or]der and stre[ng]th[ened] the fastenings beneath. He returned, [he came] up to his [...] rest.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic engineering of ‘fastenings’ beneath the Porter; mythic process narrative.

paragraphs.core_text: Look at all these watches of the zon[e], the ones in which these great gods are master, w[atch]ing over them [...]. Uprisings have happened, and treachery, in them. The [...] in them from time to time; with a great hum[iliati]on, until they humbled the powers of the enmity.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution: “Then speaks the a[po]stl[e] to him:” (compilation frame marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative cosmological inference (watch-district pattern) is core; the only late element is the dialogue tag.

paragraphs.core_text: So also is this body! A mighty power lives here, even if it is small in its stature. Nevertheless, Sin dwells within, and the old man who is lodged in it. Certainly he is cruel, with great cunning; until the Lig/ht Mind finds how to humble this body, and drive it [according to] his pleasure.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Macrocosm→microcosm analogy stated as system principle (body as watch-district; Sin/old man as internal rebels).

paragraphs.core_text: Just so, in the w[atch-]districts of his great outer brothers, they who are masters in the zone: in them, in the great body, the earthquake and treachery happened from time to time. So, also, is the watch-district of the Mind, which is the body of the flesh. Sin raises [up], from time to time, its agitations in the body.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Explicit correspondence: outer watch-districts ↔ body of flesh; internal-to-system mapping.

paragraphs.core_text: Now you, understand thus, that the powers of light are good. The beginning and the end are unveiled to them. All that they do is being done with correct judgement. Indeed, because of this they may permit the enmity to initiate error, and do its pleasure for a moment. Then they seize [...] they have acted first with a righteous judgement.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Theodicy/providence logic stated cosmologically (powers of light vs enmity) without institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: And [with resp]ect to this other (question) that you have put forward: How may the Light Mind come, this great and honoured mighty one, and assume this little body of the flesh? Again, look, see! These gods, in that [...] are great and mighty ones. And each one of them is enclosed and hard pressed in this place wherein he is set; like trees holding to their taproot. So also this is how each one of them has held to his taproot in the world, according to the k[ind] of place in which he is set, bearing up till [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal explanatory analogy (enclosed gods in their stations) applied to Light Mind’s embodiment; still system-description.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, also, happen you know [...] the world is set firm, being ordered [...] the five sons of the Living Spirit in all its members [...]. Sin took this body out from [the] la[nd (?) ... co]nstructed it in its members. It took its [bod]y from the five b]odies of darkness. (Sin) constructed the body. Yet, its [sou]l i[t] took from the five shining gods.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Despite the algorithmic seam flag, the paragraph stays cosmos→cosmos (five sons; five bodies of darkness; five shining gods) and continues the five-fold microcosmic construction logic.

paragraphs.core_text: (Sin) bou]nd (the soul) in the five members of the body. It bound the mind in bone; the thought in sinew; the insight in vein; the counsel in flesh; the consideration in ski[n].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Canonical five-fold correspondence (intellectual faculties ↔ body tissues) is substrate-like, purely structural.

paragraphs.core_text: (Sin) set f[ast] its five powers: its mind upon the mind of the soul; its thought upon the thought of the soul; its insight upon the insight of the soul; its counsel upon the counsel of the soul; its consider[atio]n upon the consideration of the soul. It placed its five [an]gels and authorities upon the five members of the soul, which it had brought in and bound in the flesh. They [...], pronouncing to the soul and continually leading it on to every evil thi[n]g,
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed institutional/polemical application that leaves the cosmic system: the catalogue of contemporary ‘sins of lust’, ‘worship of idols’, ‘idols of wood and gold and silver’, etc. This is cosmos→editorial religious landscape rather than cosmos→cosmos mapping.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The five-on-five overlay mechanism is core; the appended anti-idolatry polemic is a later application layer.

paragraphs.core_text: (The soul) assumed error and forgetfulness. It for[go]t its essence and its race and its kindred; kn[ow]ing not the door of the place to pray to him, nor call up to him. It became hostile to its father [...] itself, being wicked [...] its own light [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic-psychological consequence (forgetting essence/kindred) flows from the five-fold binding; still not institutional.

paragraphs.core_text: The Light Mind comes and finds the soul [...] it assuming it in the [...] its wisdom [...] he shall become for it [...] the bonds [...] members in the body. He shall loosen the m[ind of the soul and relea]se it from the bone. He shall release the th[ought of the soul] from the sinew; and s[o] bind the thought [of the Sin in] the sinew. He shall release the insight of the soul from the vei[n]; and so bind the insight of the Sin in the vein. [He sh]all loosen the counsel of the soul, and release it from the flesh; and so bind the counsel of the Sin in the flesh. He shall release the consideration of the soul from the skin; and bin[d] the consideration of the Sin in the skin.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Perfectly substrate-like reversal operation: release/bind across corresponding members; impersonal mechanics.

paragraphs.core_text: This is how he shall release the members of the soul, and make them free from the five members of Sin. Conversely, these five members of Sin, which were loose, he shall bind them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Five-fold system restated as lawlike mechanism (freeing/binding), fully internal to the cosmology.

paragraphs.core_text: He shall set right the members of the soul; form and purify them, and construct a new man of them, a child of righteousness. [And] when [he] fashions and const[r]ucts and purifies the new man; then he shall bring forth five great living members out from the five great memb[ers]. And he places them in the members of the new man. He shall place his m[ind], which is love, in the mind of the new man. Also, the th[oug]ht, which is faith, he shall pl[ace in] the thought of the new man; whom he shall purify. His insight, which [is perfection, he shall place] in the insight of the new man. His counsel, which [is] patience, he shall place in his counsel. Also, [w]isdom, which is his consideration, in the consideration of the new m[an]. He shall make the image of the word pure from the word of Sin; and he adds to it his word, so that his [...] becomes nourisher and strengthener [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic five-to-five transformation: virtues correspond to liberated faculties; still presented as structural process, not church discipline.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, when he shall perf[ect ... the tw]elve members. This [is how ...] and his wisdom. His [...] becomes righteous, as he perf[ects ...] While formerly he was running [...] but instead of this, now he runs [...] his road and his path and his [...] also [he mounts up] to the heights, to the great aeons [...] thus the old man is bound in the [...] and his lust, his [...] his foolishness in these five members of the bo[dy ...] the dark spirit is imprisoned with them in a bond and in severe misery.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continuation of transformation mechanics (twelve-members completion; ascent); still not anchored to institutions.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, the new man reigns by his love, by hi[s] faith, by his perfection, by his patience, and by his wisdom. Yet, his king [...] the Light Mind, he w[ho is] king over the totality. He re[igns] o[ver it according to] his pleasure. While the members [...], thus Sin is imprisoned. Still, the Light Mind is king, and an affliction may arise in the body from t[im]e to time.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Five-virtue reign + higher kingship of Light Mind: degree-structured anthropology (core).

paragraphs.core_text: There are occasions when Sin shall mount up with its foolishness; and it disturbs the consideration, and it clouds the wisdom and the understanding of the person. It causes truth to be split into doubt in him, and he utters some foo[li]sh words and some [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Relapse mechanics described as internal disturbance of faculties; no institutional ‘fix’ yet, so still core psychological-cosmic teaching.
Institutional response sequence: “in the church, the teachers… presbyters shall gather…”—community governance, not cosmic correspondence.
Exhortational/community-management register (“rebuke… edification of his brethren…”) with application voice; editorial pastoral drift.
Behavioral/institutional diagnostics (separating from teacher/brethren; solitary habits).
Church-based intervention (“wise ones of the church shall gather…”) and moral exhortation; institutional layer.
Concluding moral assurance about victory over Sin, embedded in the pastoral disciplinary sequence.
Application to relations with “teacher… instructor… love of the church”; institutional anchoring (cosmos→community life).
Explicit separation from church and return to ‘worldly men’; community boundary-policing typical of later pastoral layer.

paragraphs.core_text: [T]hen, have I taught you, and opened your (sg.) [eyes], as to how confusion shall arise in the zo[ne], in the camps of these great mig[hty] gods? Again, this is how disturbance shall come about, from ti[me] to time, in the [...] of the [Li]ght [M]ind.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Returns to macrocosm patterning (zone/camps) and correlates it to Light Mind disturbances—systemic correspondence voice.

paragraphs.core_text: So al[so] these watch-keepers, for they are set [...] fi[rm in] the zone, (but) they are not visible. Again, this too is the way of the Light Mind, [for he is] not visible in the body.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Explicit correspondence (invisible watch-keepers ↔ invisible Light Mind) is core.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, [corr]esponding to th[ese] outer [watch-keepers]: in that while they are great, [y]et have they contorted themselves. They have [...], they have become small, to the measure of the task that is apportioned to each o[n]e [of t]hem. Again, this too is like the Mind, himse[lf] a great one, and exalted; but he is bent over and [has] become small, to this little worthless [bo]dy.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Degree/condensation teaching (great→small by office) presented as lawlike correspondence; core style.

paragraphs.core_text: [Even so] the gods in the outer [z]one: they are transcendent and purified, they are set [f]a[st in] the mingling of the totality, (but) are not defiled. [This too is like the] Light [Mind]. While he is placed in hi[s ...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Purity-within-mingling principle stated cosmologically; correspondence applied to Light Mind in body.

paragraphs.core_text: Again, behold the mightiness and the activity of the Light Mind: how vast he is over all the watch-districts of the body! He stays fast at his camp. He shuts off all deliberations of the body from the beguilements of Sin. He limits them and distributes them out. He sets them down at his pleasure.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal governance mechanics of faculties (‘deliberations… limits… distributes’) in correspondence with watch-district control.

paragraphs.core_text: Also, he does another work, surpassing and ex/ceeding (these). He bestows a great spirit upon the ele/ct one. Indeed, now may you find him, as he stands on the earth, [r]ising up in his heart and ascending to the Father, the G[o]d of truth. He who exists and is established above all the things of loss. [Onc]e again, he may push dow[n] in his insight and his consideration, and descend to the land of Darkness, from where the Darkness has poured forth. His heart shall run and touch everything, as it [...]
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mystical anthropology expressed as macrocosmic mobility of faculties (ascend/descend) still within the cosmological system; ‘elect’ may reflect later communal terminology, but the operation remains system-internal rather than institutional regulation.

paragraphs.core_text: I have taught you] the deeds of the [Light] Mind! Whoever has an open and percept[ive] eye, [he can] appear to him. Whoever has not that eye, he can not appear to him.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed dialogue attribution: “Then he says to [th]at discip[le:” (compilation frame marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Aphoristic visibility doctrine (perceptive eye) fits teaching voice; mixed only due to the dialogue tag.
Transition into self-referential ‘my work… my leadership’—hagiographic/apostolic frame, not core cosmology.
Autobiographical boast (“I, a single Manichaios…”) and contemporary world/wealth imagery; hagiographic layer.
Victorious-apostle rhetoric over cities/countries; biographical apologetic typical of compilation/community frame.
Application voice + political powers (“kings… nobles… officials”); hagiographic defense of Mani’s authority.
Self-praise of liberating ‘children/brothers/kin’; community/leadership rhetoric rather than system mapping.
Protective ‘breastplate of wisdom’ for ‘my children’; institutional leader voice, not impersonal cosmology.
Explicit church-building and offices (“elect[ion]… apostle… of the church… my church… apostles and ambassa[d]ors I have sent”): hagiographic/institutional layer.
Comparative apostolic boasting (“former apo[st]les… apart from Jesus only”); community legitimation frame.
Grand hagiographic closure claim (“door… opened by me… to the gods and the angels and mankind”); not core exposition.
Formal closing response/praise and promise of obedience (“commandments… faith”); editorial frame conclusion.
